en.title: Bookmarks of the Night Journey, Incantations of Mud
en.premise: Returning to his hometown for the first time in decades following his grandfather's death, the protagonist is drawn to a peculiar secondhand bookstore standing on the outskirts of the village. Within its walls lie ledgers documenting the 'lives' of the villagers, and a 'last train' that appears only on certain days, ferrying unwanted memories and souls to the underworld. After breaking a taboo and uncovering a past meant to be forgotten, he becomes entangled in a cycle of cruel sacrificial rituals that the village has performed for generations.

zh.title: 《夜行之栞，泥之祝词》
zh.premise: 因祖父去世，数十年后重返故乡的主人公，被引向了村庄边缘一家诡异的旧书店。书店中保存着记录村民“人生”的账簿，而仅在特定日期出现的“末班列车”，正将那些被抛弃的记忆与人类运往冥界。在打破禁忌、解读了本该被抹去的过去后，主人公被卷入了一场村庄世代相传的残酷祭祀仪式之中。
